note: Predicate for the local capture of godbolt-clang-probe.hlsl, the small source published to Compiler Explorer for the Clang panes. It exists so the published file is not an untested variant: the local build must agree that this is valid HLSL and that the vertex entry lowers SV_ShadingRate as a system value. If a reader later sees a Clang error on that pane, this capture is what rules out 'the file was wrong'. Both clauses are positive; the second uses the SysValue-column token SHDINGRATE, which the PSV runtime-info copy of the signature tables never prints.

value.note: DXC accepts the probe file's vertex entry point.
and lowers the semantic into the vertex Output signature as a system value.
